title: Blended Program
summary: Instructor-led learning that mixes self-paced online content with scheduled classroom sessions — batches with seat limits, an approval step, session attendance and assignments.

title: Course
summary: The standard self-paced unit of learning — one-click enrolment, node-by-node progress, Karma Points and a certificate on completion.

title: Curated Program
summary: An editorially assembled collection of courses enrolled as one unit — auto-assigned batch, progress rolled up from the child courses.

title: My Assigned Courses
summary: Courses pushed to a learner by their organisation — resolved by an access-settings rules engine, including external partner (CIOS) courses.

title: Standalone Assessment
summary: An assessment published as its own learning object, outside any course: creators build multi-section question sets with marks-based or psychometric scoring, negative marking, sectional cutoffs and 3x randomization; it is offered openly, MDO-moderated or invite-only in scheduled batches, with resilient test delivery, capped re-attempts and a certificate only on passing.

title: Comprehensive Assessment Program
summary: A program-level assessment category, typically assigned/mandated, that reuses the assessment engine end to end.

title: Learning Pathway
summary: A guided, multi-stage journey — milestones of courses and checkpoints that unlock one at a time.

title: Bharat Kalp
summary: Bharat KALP (Knowledge, Action & Leadership Program) is a restricted microsite for IAS officers in the CBC's leadership programme: a 16-week structured curriculum with progress tracking, curated course recommendations, configurable banners and announcements, private mentorship communities, and program-only talks and podcasts with live meeting links, built by reusing existing platform services.

title: Peer Validation
summary: A named colleague, not a machine, has to approve a course completion before it counts.

title: CHS
summary: A nightly batch pipeline — not a page or a button — that turns raw platform activity into karma points, badges, leaderboards, compliance reports and the BI warehouse.

title: AI CBP Tool
summary: Turns a department's own Work Allocation Order and other source documents into a designation-by-designation Capacity Building Plan — role profile, competencies, and a course list — reviewed, approved and published by an MDO admin.

title: Search
summary: Platform-wide search: an Elasticsearch-backed content/people/community search fronted by every portal and the mobile app, plus an independent LLM keyword-extraction step that two of five clients call before they search.

title: Events Hub
summary: The synchronous and interactive virtual learning subsystem of the iGOT Karmayogi platform. It governs the full lifecycle of virtual sessions — MDO authoring, SPV editorial review and publishing, cohort-based access control, live streaming and in-session chat, watch-time completion tracking, verifiable certificates, and post-event reporting — linking attendance to the Karmayogi Competency Model.

title: Unenrollment of Courses
summary: A learner-initiated withdrawal from a course/batch — one boolean flip on the same generic enrolment record enroll writes, blocked once the course is completed, and wired up very differently depending on which client the learner is standing in.

title: Moderated Content
summary: Two unrelated systems sharing one name: an MDO-restricted courseCategory/secureSettings visibility scheme for Moderated Course/Program/Assessment riding on the generic Sunbird review workflow, and an independent ML text-profanity check on discussion posts.

title: User Onboarding
summary: How a person gets an account — public sign-up, a department's registration link or QR code, an admin adding them, or government single sign-on — and the admin steps behind it. Registering submits a request; the account is created afterwards.

title: SPV & Admin Registration
summary: The platform-owner side of onboarding, done from the SPV / super-admin portal: creating organisations, putting their first administrators in place, publishing registration links, and approving requests for new organisations, designations and email domains.

title: Marketplace
summary: A partner/external-content ecosystem layered alongside the native Course pipeline — third-party providers are registered, licensed, and have their catalogs ingested through a separate storage, enrollment and entitlement stack that only loosely interoperates with native platform content.

title: AI Assessment Tool
summary: AssessAI (the iGOT AI Assessment Generator) generates, evaluates, refines and governs curriculum-aligned assessments: it turns course material or Karmayogi Competency Model selections into KCM- and Bloom-aligned question banks that creators review, edit and export for the LMS.

title: Competency Hub
summary: Two parallel competency taxonomies — a real CRUD+review service (frac-backend) almost nothing calls, and a mirror inside Knowledge Platform (kcmfinal_fw) that most of the platform calls instead — plus the Passbook, browse/search and org-designation-mapping surfaces built on top.

title: Discussion Hub
summary: A community-scoped Q&A/forum feature — MDO leaders create Communities, Karmayogis join and post Questions, other members answer with Answer Posts and nested Answer Post Replies, all owned by one backend service.

title: Bulk Registration
summary: Uploading a CSV of new users to create many accounts at once — except the platform actually has three independent, largely disconnected implementations of this, and the backend endpoint named for "bulk create" creates exactly one user per call.

title: Weekly Claps
summary: Weekly Claps is the learner engagement streak on the home page: a learner earns a clap for every week with at least 60 minutes of platform time, consecutive weeks build a streak that resets after a missed week, and a nightly batch job computes it from telemetry, keeps a rolling four-week history and triggers in-app review prompts for engaged learners.

title: Karma Points
summary: An event-sourced recognition ledger — services emit events, one Flink job decides and writes every point, and the apps read it back as history, rank and a convertible Karma Coin wallet.

title: Training Plan
summary: The Capacity Building Plan (CBP), Training Plans and APAR framework lets MDOs and Cadre Controlling Authorities curate, assign, track and enforce targeted learning for civil servants: reusable cohort targeting, in-flight plan edits that keep learner progress, Level-2 Comprehensive Assessments, and automatic feeding of mandatory training and assessment results into annual appraisals (SPARROW, state e-PAR, e-HRMS).

title: Amrit Gyaan Kosh
summary: Amrit Gyaan Kosh (AGK) is iGOT's knowledge repository of government case studies: MDOs and the Capacity Building Commission author Case Studies with Teacher's Notes and reference material, tagged by year, SDGs, state/UT and sector; learners discover and consume them on web and mobile, public users can browse without logging in, and multilingual authoring extends them across languages.

title: Organisation Hierarchy
summary: How a ministry or state lays out the organisations under it as a tree, up to ten levels deep — edited node by node in a tree view or loaded in one go from a spreadsheet — so the rest of the platform can answer "who sits under whom".

title: Explore Content
summary: The platform-wide discovery surface — global search, the Explore menu, facet browsing and every “see all” listing, served by the composite search APIs.
